situation: A real three-part ask that genuinely needed its evidence: agent file counts, an absent licence file, and which installed snapshots carried a copy. All of it sits in a context block above a horizontal rule, and none of it is repeated in the ask.
why_this_ask: The instance the standard's separated-context clause had been missing since slice 01. Its context block carries an artifact path — a token the ask may not contain — which is what makes the clause a used escape hatch rather than an unexercised one.
co_occurring: None. This is the only fixture that passes all four checks with an emission recorded, so it is the passing side of BARE-LIST and BURIED-ASK.
